title: Best AI Mobile App Builder for Booking and Appointment Apps in 2026
summary: We scored seven AI mobile app builders on the eight things that matter to a local business booking app: availability, reminders, payments and deposits, client records, and staff logins.
body_markdown:
Blink, at 72 out of 80, because it builds availability, push reminders, Stripe deposits, client records, and staff roles on one database. Adalo is second at 58.


Yes. Blink connects Stripe from a description. Apple's guideline 3.1.3(e) says services consumed outside the app use methods such as Apple Pay or card entry rather than in-app purchase.


With a native app and push notifications, yes. Blink adds push from a sentence, while Base44's web view wrapper has no native push.


Yes. Blink creates roles such as owner, staff, and front desk, with row-level security so each sees the right records.


Blink connects the app to 63 tools including Gmail, Slack, HubSpot, and Google Sheets. Base44 also lists native integrations into common business tools.
